# Awesome Remote Job

> A curated, actively-maintained list of remote job boards, companies with genuine "remote DNA," relocation and visa resources, and tools for building a remote working career. Every entry is vetted for quality — no paywalls, no forced logins — and dead links are checked on every change.

## Core Sections

- [FAQ](https://github.com/sheepdontmoo/awesome-remote-job/blob/master/README.md#faq): Direct answers on finding legitimate remote jobs and identifying remote-first companies.
- [Job boards](https://github.com/sheepdontmoo/awesome-remote-job/blob/master/README.md#job-boards): Vetted remote job boards without paywalls or forced logins.
- [Job boards aggregators](https://github.com/sheepdontmoo/awesome-remote-job/blob/master/README.md#job-boards-aggregators): Sites that aggregate listings across multiple remote job boards.
- [Companies with "remote DNA"](https://github.com/sheepdontmoo/awesome-remote-job/blob/master/README.md#companies-with-remote-dna): Companies built around remote work as a core practice, not just remote-friendly.
- [Interviewing](https://github.com/sheepdontmoo/awesome-remote-job/blob/master/README.md#interviewing): Resources for interviewing successfully for remote roles.
